::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 247,774 people lived in County Kildare, up 11.4% on 2016. It had the 4th largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 2.2 times its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Kildare was €1,701, the third highest of the 26 counties.
:::
